reason: Spark, Todoist and Calendly already work for me and I know where everything is. Moving my whole business into a new app for another $12 a month is a big switch, and nothing I have is actually broken.
objection: It's $12 a month on top of what I already pay, unless I drop my other tools, and I'm not going to bet my client email and calendar on an app I've never heard of. If it's worse than Spark at email or Todoist at tasks, I've lost more than I gained.
would_change_my_mind: If it clearly replaced Spark and Todoist so my total bill went down, and I could try it on one real client for the free trial without moving everything over.
